daemon.description: Run nast in background/daemon mode and turn off stdout.

interface.description: Select the network interface to sniff on. Empty for auto-detect.

filter.description: Apply a pcap-style filter to sniffer.

log_file.description: Log all packets to the specified filename.

log_data_file.description: Log only captured data (payload) to the specified filename.

check_promisc.description: Check other NICs on the LAN with the promiscuous flag set. Use 'all' for all nodes.

host_list.description: Map the LAN by performing a series of ARP requests.

tcp_stream.description: List of TCP connections to follow. Each item defines the two ends of the stream.

reset_connection.description: List of connections to reset. Each item defines the two ends of the stream.

port_scanner.description: List of hosts to scan. Each item defines the host and port range.

multi_port_scanner.description: Perform half-open port scan on all hosts of the LAN.

find_link.description: Determine if the LAN uses a Hub or Switch.

daemon_banner.description: Check the most famous daemon banner on the LAN's hosts.

check_arp_poisoning.description: Control ARP answers to discover possible ARP spoofing attacks.

byte_counting.description: Apply traffic counting to a filter. Use 'any' for no filter.

ncurses.description: Run Nast with the ncurses interfaces.
